'''Françoise Tisseur''' is a [[Numerical analysis|numerical analyst]] and Professor of Numerical Analysis<ref name="FTHP"/><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.manchester.ac.uk/research/francoise.tisseur|title=Françoise Tisseur – Personal Details|author=University of Manchester|accessdate=October 25, 2010}}</ref>
at the [[Department of Mathematics, University of Manchester]], UK. 
She works in [[numerical linear algebra]] and in particular on [[Nonlinear eigenproblem|nonlinear eigenvalue problem]]s and  structured [[matrix (mathematics)|matrix]] problems, 
including the development of algorithms and software.<ref name="FTHP"/><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.manchester.ac.uk/research/francoise.tisseur/research|title=Françoise Tisseur – Research|author=University of Manchester|accessdate=August 26, 2012}}</ref>

She is a graduate of the
[[:fr:Université de Saint-Étienne|University of St-Etienne]],  France, from where she gained her 
Maitrise (Mathematical Engineering) in 1993,
Diplome d'Etude Approfondie in 1994, and PhD (Numerical Analysis) in 1997.

She has contributed software to [[LAPACK]], [[ScaLAPACK]], and the [[MATLAB]] distribution.

Tisseur is a member of the editorial boards of the SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications, the IMA Journal of Numerical Analysis and the Electronic Journal of Linear Algebra.

== Awards and honours ==

Tisseur was awarded the 2010 [[Whitehead Prize]] by the [[London Mathematical Society]] for her research achievements in numerical linear algebra, including polynomial eigenvalue and structured matrix problems.<ref name="WHP"/>
She was awarded the 2011–2012 [[Adams Prize]] of the [[University of Cambridge]]
for her work on [[polynomial eigenvalue problem]]s<ref name="AP"/> and holds a Royal Society Wolfson Research Merit Award in 2014–2019.<ref name="WRMA" />  She delivered the Olga Taussky-Tood Lecture at the International Congress on Industrial and Applied Mathematics in Valencia, Spain, in 2019.<ref name="OTT">{{Cite web|url=http://www.iciam.org/olga-taussky-todd-lecture-iciam-2019|title=The Olga Taussky-Todd Lecture at ICIAM 2019 {{!}} ICIAM|website=www.iciam.org|language=en|access-date=2018-10-10}}</ref> She is the 2020 winner of the [[Fröhlich Prize]] of the [[London Mathematical Society]] "for her important and highly innovative contributions to the analysis, perturbation theory, and numerical solution of nonlinear eigenvalue problems".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/sites/lms.ac.uk/files/files/Tisseur_Frohlich_citation.pdf|publisher=London Mathematical Society|date=2020|accessdate=2020-06-27|title=Fröhlich Prize: Citation for Françoise Tisseur}}</ref>

Tisseur became a Fellow of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] in 2016 "for contributions to numerical linear algebra, especially numerical methods for eigenvalue problems".<ref>[http://fellows.siam.org/index.php?sort=year&value=2016 SIAM Fellows Class of 2016]</ref> She held an EPSRC Leadership Fellowship in 2011–2016,<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.manchester.ac.uk/discover/news/world-leading-academics-awarded-prestigious-fellowships/|title='World-leading' academics awarded prestigious fellowships|access-date=2018-10-17|language=en}}</ref> and is a Fellow of the Institute of Mathematics and its Applications.
